<thought>Using the molecular formula C7H12NO, the double bond equivalents are calculated as DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H)/2 = (2*7 + 2 + 1 - 12)/2 = (14 + 2 + 1 - 12)/2 = 5/2 = 2.5, which rounds to the nearest whole number of 2 for typical organic compounds.</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
